primary_finding.finding: The deterministic shuffle key includes template id, base semantic state, query polarity and S3 permutation. Therefore display order is not an independently randomized nuisance variable; it is generated from variables that determine the target class.
primary_finding.formula: 4 TRAIN templates * 3 base states * 2 polarities * 6 S3 mappings
primary_finding.interpretation_boundary: The 88.19% value is an empirical nuisance-signature lookup diagnostic over the deterministic generated blueprint, not an out-of-sample model accuracy claim. The decisive structural failure is that zero of 127 nuisance signatures retain all three target classes as possible outcomes.
primary_finding.consequence: A learner can exploit generator scheduling/context regularities rather than learn semantic-evidence-to-episode-codebook binding. Marginal class-symbol balance and a deterministic shuffle are insufficient anti-shortcut guarantees.

swarm_review.DATASET_ARCHITECT: FAIL: display order is scheduled from target-generating variables instead of independently factorialized.
swarm_review.ADVERSARIAL_SHORTCUT_HUNTER: CRITICAL_FAIL: 110/127 nuisance signatures uniquely identify the target class and none retain all three classes.
swarm_review.STATISTICAL_REVIEWER: FAIL: marginal order-only MI is small but conditional nuisance MI is 1.34885 bits; marginal balance hides higher-order leakage.
swarm_review.CAUSAL_BINDING_REVIEWER: FAIL_FOR_TRAINING: counterfactual S3 balance does not isolate semantic binding when presentation scheduling remains target-conditioned.
swarm_review.CONVERGENCE_REVIEWER: Use the current v2 full-cross display-order mechanism as donor. Do not create a second semantic authority; repair/fuse v3 proof-topology features onto a nuisance-independent factorial schedule.
swarm_review.FINAL_ADJUDICATOR: v3 remains useful donor/source research, but direct training use is blocked until conditional nuisance support passes.

recommended_repair.minimum: For every fixed semantic scenario, lexical realization, query polarity and S3 mapping, emit all six display orders with the same target; across evidence states, retain all three semantic target classes for every nuisance signature.
required_regressions: all-three target-class support per nuisance signature
all-three target-slot support per nuisance signature
six display orders per fixed semantic scenario/polarity/mapping
nuisance-only decoder at chance by construction or preregistered tolerance
conditional MI gate in addition to marginal MI

research_feedback.training_implication: The binding curriculum should teach an operator invariant to presentation order, not merely survive a pseudorandom order schedule.
research_feedback.harness_implication: Future Xeno evaluation should include nuisance-only baselines that receive template/style, polarity, realized mapping and presentation features but no semantic evidence. Any above-chance shortcut blocks binder promotion.
research_feedback.general_clay_rule: A deterministic generator can be perfectly reproducible and still leak the target. Reproducibility and independence are separate properties.
research_feedback.falsifier: If the repaired full-cross generator still permits a nuisance-only classifier above the preregistered chance tolerance on frozen unseen families, the remaining shortcut source must be isolated before training promotion.

next_exact_action: Converge the v3 proof-topology/router-isolation donors onto the v2 full-cross nuisance schedule, add the conditional nuisance-support regression, and only then proceed toward exact 46-atom/tokenizer-bound materialization.
